svg.title: High-level multi-source host APT architecture
svg.desc: Proposed functional architecture: endpoint multi-source logs, local ML and novelty triage, central graph and temporal analysis, fusion, analyst review, persistent storage, and a gated retraining and deployment loop.
svg.text: END HOST · MONITOR, DETECT, SEND EVIDENCE
ONE CENTRAL VM · MULTIPLE SERVICES / CONTAINERS
LEARNING LIFECYCLE · SERVICES ON THE CENTRAL VM
Select and forward logs, scores and evidence
Normalize source schemas; correlate host / process / time; retain source provenance
Construct causal host/process context and ordered event sequences
Window length and prediction target are explicit configuration; align evidence availability
Host ML score + graph context / cascade
Map event-level output to the shared target
Target source adapters require training / validation
Align local ML, graph and sequence evidence to a shared host / time target
Gating / cross-attention + source masks; calibrate on validation
Produce APT assessment, confidence and supporting evidence
Investigate alerts / unknown cases → adjudicated labels and reviewed errors
Trigger: sustained drift OR reviewed decline
Drift alone does not create labels
Retrain ML / fine-tune DL as appropriate
Promote only if policy is satisfied
Roll out to eligible model services
OpTC + external datasets → adapters / label review
Additional data requires training to change weights
Persistent storage / mounted volume attached to the Central VM
Raw logs • processed events / sequences • evidence and label provenance
Verified datasets + replay buffer (trainer / validator) • model versions + metadata (registry)
Ingestion / analysis / review services read and write their corresponding logical stores
Multi-source Host APT Detection — High-level Architecture
Target design • endpoint monitoring + central contextual analysis + validated model updates
Runtime integration is proposed; existing model experiments do not establish an operational deployment.
Reviewed labels / errors + operational drift metrics
Approved model versions → endpoint and central inference services
Amber dashed: data / evidence exchange • Red: update / rollout • Lam benchmark: Zeek-based inputs remain documented separately.
